claude.description: Claude Code, signed in with a Claude subscription. The token comes from `claude setup-token` and lives in .env as CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN. Model and effort are the CLI's own defaults (the owner chose defaults), so boxSettings is empty on purpose.

opencode.description: OpenCode on the free OpenCode Zen tier. The CLI is not in the stock Box, so worker/setup.sh installs it into the image. UNVERIFIED until the smoke test: whether Zen needs a credential at all. The auth block below copies a local `opencode auth login` into the Box the way Codex does; if the smoke test shows Zen works with no credential, delete this block rather than leave a secret that does nothing.
opencode.promptExtra: When you are done, write your summary to the file {summary}, and nothing else to that file.

pi.description: Pi (pi.dev), BYOK. Print mode is its headless mode and auto-approves, so nobody has to answer a prompt in a Box. The secret is the content of ~/.pi/agent/auth.json after `/login`; UNVERIFIED until the smoke test whether the Box's home is /workspace/home or /home/boxuser for pi, and adjust the path if not.
